title: Mirroring the Mind: Distilling Human-Like Metacognitive Strategies into Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving reasoning capabilities and structural stability in Large Language Models using a post-training framework called Metacognitive Behavioral Tuning (MBT). It uses established benchmarks like HotpotQA and MuSiQue for performance evaluation but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
